identity.name: River Watch Design System
core_principles: Fusion: Naval HUD meets Modern SaaS
Clarity: High contrast for sunlight/night visibility
Hierarchy: Critical data (Time to Lock) > Context (Map) > Details (Vessel List)
Tactility: Glassmorphism with sharp 1px borders (no muddy shadows)

usage_rules: Body Text: Manrope, weight 400/500, relaxed leading
Data/Metrics: JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums for changing numbers
Labels/Overlines: Rajdhani, Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-widest, text-muted-foreground

scale.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight

dashboard_structure.desktop: grid grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 h-screen overflow-hidden

areas.map: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 xl:col-span-9 row-span-full relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10
areas.sidebar: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 xl:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-4 h-full overflow-y-auto pr-2

cards.classes: bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl rounded-xl

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider font-heading rounded-sm shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(6,182,212,0.5)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white border border-white/10 font-heading uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm

badges.classes: rounded-sm px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border

inputs.classes: bg-slate-950/50 border-white/10 focus:border-cyan-500/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500/50 rounded-sm font-mono text-sm

hud_elements.corners: Use .hud-border class for critical data containers to add corner brackets
hud_elements.scanlines: Optional subtle scanline overlay for 'retro-tech' feel on map

images.logo_placeholder: Use text 'RIVER WATCH' in Rajdhani Bold with a cyan radar icon

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. LANDING PAGE: Create a new LandingPage.js. Use the 'landing_hero' image as a full-screen background with a heavy dark overlay (bg-slate-950/80). Center the value proposition: 'Beat the Traffic. Master the River.'

2. DASHBOARD LAYOUT: Refactor Dashboard.js to use the 'Bento Grid' layout defined above. The Map must be the hero. The 'Lock Timing' calculator should be a floating glass panel ON TOP of the map on mobile, or a dedicated sidebar card on desktop.
3. HEADER CLEANUP: Remove the 'badge soup'. Group status indicators (GPS, WS, Lock) into a single 'System Status' compact dropdown or minimal icon row. Only show text labels on hover.
4. COLOR DISCIPLINE: Stop using random colors. Map every color to a meaning: Cyan=Safe/Active, Amber=Warning/Wait, Red=Danger/Stop. Convert all other colors to Slate scales.
5. TYPOGRAPHY: Enforce Rajdhani for ALL headers and labels. Enforce JetBrains Mono for ALL numbers (speed, coordinates, time).
6. MOBILE OPTIMIZATION: Ensure all touch targets are 44px+. Use a bottom sheet (Drawer) for the vessel list on mobile instead of cramping the screen.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not use rounded-full for buttons (use rounded-sm or rounded-md for tactical feel).
Always add data-testid to interactive elements.
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
